question: What were Texas Roadhouse's trailing-twelve-month total revenue and income-from-operations margin as of the end of its fiscal Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026)?
grading: Computation: TTM = FY2025 + 26 weeks 2026 - 26 weeks 2025. TTM total revenue USD 6,231.5M (6,231,515K); TTM income from operations USD 482.8M (482,795K); margin 7.75% (+/-0.2pp). Accept +/-0.5% on dollar figures. Fail if the window is not the 52 weeks ended June 30, 2026 or if net income is substituted.
answer: TTM total revenue = 5,878,075 (FY2025) + 3,313,142 (26 weeks to June 30, 2026) - 2,959,702 (26 weeks to July 1, 2025) = USD 6,231,515 thousand (USD 6,231.5 million). TTM income from operations = 474,740 + 289,129 - 281,074 = USD 482,795 thousand (USD 482.8 million). TTM operating margin = 482,795 / 6,231,515 = 7.75% [H13-E1][H13-E2].

output.answer:
## Texas Roadhouse (TXRH) — TTM as of fiscal Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026)

**Trailing-twelve-month total revenue: ~$6.23 billion**
**TTM income-from-operations margin: ~7.7%** (income from operations ≈ $482.8M)

### How I derived it (TTM = FY2025 + H1 2026 − H1 2025)

| Component | Total revenue | Income from operations |
|---|---|---|
| FY2025 (ended Dec 30, 2025) | $5,878.1M | $474.7M |
| H1 2026 (26 wks ended Jun 30, 2026) | $3,313.1M | $289.1M |
| Less H1 2025 (26 wks ended Jul 1, 2025) | −$2,959.7M | −$281.1M |
| **TTM ending Jun 30, 2026** | **≈ $6,231.5M** | **≈ $482.8M** |

**Margin = $482.8M ÷ $6,231.5M ≈ 7.75%**

### Supporting quarterly figures
- **Q2 2026** (13 wks ended Jun 30, 2026): total revenue $1,679.976M; income from operations $142.788M (~8.5% margin)
- **Q1 2026** (13 wks ended Mar 31, 2026): total revenue $1,633.166M; income from operations $146.341M
- Q2 2026 revenue grew 11.1% YoY; H1 revenue grew 11.9%

**Note:** The revenue figure ($6.232B) corroborates independent data aggregators. The ~7.7% TTM margin is my calculation using GAAP "income from operations" over total revenue. Some data providers report a slightly higher TTM operating margin (e.g., ~8.5%), which typically reflects a different operating-income definition or a single-quarter (not TTM) basis, so treat the margin as definition-dependent.

**Sources:**
- Texas Roadhouse Q2 2026 earnings release: https://investor.texasroadhouse.com/news/news-details/2026/Texas-Roadhouse-Inc--Announces-Second-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx
- Texas Roadhouse Q1 2026 earnings release: https://investor.texasroadhouse.com/news/news-details/2026/Texas-Roadhouse-Inc--Announces-First-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx
- Texas Roadhouse Q4/FY2025 earnings release: https://investor.texasroadhouse.com/news/news-details/2026/Texas-Roadhouse-Inc--Announces-Fourth-Quarter-2025-Results/default.aspx
